name: afrihub-monorepo
description: AfriHub - Pan-African Tech Community Showcase Website

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "shared,frontend,backend" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=@afrihub/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/shared && npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@afrihub/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@afrihub/backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && USE_TEST_DB=true concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --workspace=@afrihub/backend" "npm run preview --workspace=@afrihub/frontend -- --port 4173 --host"
